newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chechnya guarantees safety of Azeri oil - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Chechnya guarantees safety of Azeri oil - Tass.

text.p: Chechnya's new president, Aslan Maskhadov, has guaranteed the safety of Azeri oil transported through Chechnya, Itar-Tass quoted Russian Deputy Fuel and Energy Minister Anatoly Shalatov as saying on Friday.
Shalatov also said Maskhadov, winner of Sunday's post-war elections, had agreed that repairs to Chechnya's oil pipeline would begin soon.
Shalatov said the pipeline, which runs through the war-torn Chechen capital of Grozny, could be ready to operate at full capacity as early as March or April.
The pipeline, whose flow must be reversed, will transport crude oil from Azerbaijan's offshore Caspian fields to the Russian Black Sea port of Novorossiisk.
Analysts have said the pipeline came through independence-minded Chechnya's 21-month bloody conflict with Russia relatively unscathed.
Maskhadov, the former guerrilla leader, won a two-thirds majority in the poll.
